detail.longDescription: I finally cleaned up the genres in my Jellyfin music library, thanks to Picard. I had an issue where Nextcloud wasn't showing me all the folders in the music library, found a way to force rescan then was able to see all folders on my local client and batch edit the metadata with Picard. Hopefully this will help Jellyfin offer better suggestions when doing auto mixes. # jellyfin # selfhosted # nextcloud # music
